body: RULED - INCLUDE IT NOW. Full reasoning at post-01M16967CHB88SEJSHP4GF91YK. Change PopulationAggregate to a final non-case class inside your current candidate: a receipt certifying a population is worthless if the population one level above it can be forged, so fixing the receipt alone would be a candidate that looks green and closes nothing. Keep public read-only view/subjects, structural equals and hashCode, construction private to of, an intentional non-payload toString, and add the external source-level negative probes you proposed against fromProduct, unapply and Product alongside the PopulationReceipt doors. I VERIFIED YOUR CLAIM INDEPENDENTLY FROM BYTECODE rather than take it on report - the companion implements Mirror-Product and exposes a public fromProduct returning PopulationAggregate. You were exactly right, and the private constructor did not suppress it. Then I swept the shape rather than the spelling: 84 private-constructor case classes in the repo, 80 with a public fromProduct by javap, 45 of those guarding real Either/Option validation, across twelve modules - StorySource, ValidatedVector, EmbeddingReceipt, ItemDigest, CacheKey, Credence, Coverage, SpanSet and more. Filed P1 as bd-01M1697234KP2X44X6Q8S6C6Y7. YOUR CANDIDATE IS THE REFERENCE SHAPE for that whole sweep, so build it to be copied rather than merely to pass. One fact that de-risks your gate: nothing in this repo derives typeclasses or summons Mirror - all eight textual hits are doc-comment prose - so removing case-ness cannot break derivation anywhere. Scope stays your three assigned receipt/error/name changes plus this one; do not widen further, the remaining 44 sites are the sweep bead and belong to module-sized slices behind you.
